proposals.before: In the sixth year of Tianfu (1120), Jin routed the Liao armies and the Liao emperor fled toward the Yin Mountains. Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to Liao's aid and camped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.
proposals.after: In the sixth year of Tianfu (1122), Jin routed the Liao armies and the Liao emperor fled toward the Yin Mountains. Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to Liao's aid and camped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.
proposals.reason: Jin Tianfu 1 = AD 1117, so Tianfu 6 = AD 1122, not 1120.

proposals.before: In the third month of Tianhui 2, Qianshun dispatched Baligong Liang and others with the sworn memorial: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month Wang Jieru, Left Remonstrating Grandee, and others bearing documents from the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders announced that if Xia repents its past offenses, captures and delivers the Liao emperor, seals alliance in writing, and keeps to the old Liao protocols and the sworn edict Jin has granted, then in any future emergency we shall aid each other.
proposals.after: In the third month of Tianhui 2, Qianshun dispatched Bali Gongliang and others with the sworn memorial: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month Wang Jieru, Left Remonstrating Grandee, and others bearing documents from the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders announced that if Xia repents its past offenses, captures and delivers the Liao emperor, seals alliance in writing, and keeps to the old Liao protocols and the sworn edict Jin has granted, then in any future emergency we shall aid each other.
proposals.reason: 把裏公亮 is the personal name Bali Gongliang, not a surname Baligong plus given name Liang.

proposals.before: In Tianjuan 2 King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded. Jin sent envoys to invest him, conferring Grand Preceptor of the State with the rank of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.
proposals.after: In Tianjuan 2 King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded. Jin sent envoys to invest him, conferring the ranks of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.
proposals.reason: Chinese has only 開府儀同三司上柱國; it does not mention Grand Preceptor (太師).

proposals.before: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, Xia again returned the fortresses and also requested troops to recover territory seized by Song. An edict commended them, and Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Personnel Wanyan Daji was sent to investigate the situation in Shaanxi.
proposals.after: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, Xia again returned the fortresses and also requested troops to recover territory seized by Song. An edict commended them, and Langzhong of the Ministry of Personnel Wanyan Daji was sent to investigate the situation in Shaanxi.
proposals.reason: 吏部郎中 is a Ministry of Personnel director/langzhong, not a Supervising Secretary.

proposals.before: In time his minister Ren Dedejing seized control of government and sought to carve up the Xia state.
proposals.after: In time his minister Ren Dejing seized control of government and sought to carve up the Xia state.
proposals.reason: 任得敬 is Ren Dejing; 'Dedejing' doubles the 得 syllable incorrectly.

proposals.before: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xud Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops for Tuoman Hutumen's Xia campaign; Ding urgently memorialized against it and the plan was halted, as recorded in his biography.
proposals.after: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops for Tuoman Hutumen's Xia campaign; Xu Ding urgently memorialized against it and the plan was halted, as recorded in his biography.
proposals.reason: 胥鼎 is Xu Ding; 'Xud' is a romanization error.

proposals.before: Earlier, Xia envoy Jingfang Guiqiashi Wang Lizhi had come on a diplomatic mission; before he could report home his state had fallen. An edict settled him in Jingzhao as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.
proposals.after: Earlier, Xia envoy Wang Lizhi, the Jingfang Guiqiashi, had come on a diplomatic mission; before he could report home his state had fallen. An edict settled him in Jingzhao as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.
proposals.reason: 精方匭匣使 is an office title preceding the personal name Wang Lizhi; the packet fuses title and name as if a single personal name.

decisions.reason: Jin Tianfu began in 1117, so its sixth year is 1122. The surrounding fall of Liao chronology confirms the correction.
把裏公亮 is the complete personal name Bali Gongliang. Splitting it as Baligong Liang creates a false surname boundary.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 乾順遣把裏公亮等來上誓表

decisions.reason: The Chinese confers only 開府儀同三司 and 上柱國. Grand Preceptor would require 太師 and was introduced without support.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 加開府儀同三司上柱國

decisions.after: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, Xia again returned the fortresses and also requested troops to recover territory seized by Song. An edict commended them, and Wanyan Daji, a director in the Ministry of Personnel, was sent to investigate the situation in Shaanxi.
decisions.reason: 吏部郎中 is a ministry director rather than a Supervising Secretary. The revision translates the office into readable English instead of leaving Langzhong unexplained.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 吏部郎中完顏達吉體究陝西利害

decisions.reason: 任得敬 is Ren Dejing. The existing form repeats the de syllable and is a fused-name typo.
胥鼎 is Xu Ding. Xud is an accidental extra consonant, and repeating the corrected full name in the second clause improves reference clarity.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 河東行省胥鼎選兵三萬五千

decisions.reason: 精方匭匣使 is Wang Lizhi's office and 王立之 is his name. The proposal correctly prevents the title from being read as part of the personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 夏使精方匭匣使王立之來聘

claimRetractions.reason: Baligong Liang was created solely by the rejected name boundary in the English translation; the correct Bali Gongliang claim already exists.
The accepted repair confirms that Ren Dedejing is a typographical duplication, not a textual variant. The correct Ren Dejing claim already exists.
Xud Ding is a translation typo rather than an alternate name. The extraction already contains the correct Xu Ding claim.
